headline: 今日零新片上映，蜘蛛侠与小黄人领跑热搜
headlineEn: Zero new releases today; Spider-Man and Minions top the trends
summary: 今日（2026-08-12）无新片上映，本周已有4部新片登场。热搜由《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《小黄人与大怪兽》领跑，《激情邀约》《青年华盛顿》《权力的游戏前传：龙族》同样在榜。下一波值得期待的新片是《逃出绝命街》与《OK老板娘2》。
summaryEn: No films opened today (Aug 12, 2026), but four new titles have debuted this week. Trending is led by Spider-Man: Brand New Day and Minions and the Big Monster, with Passionate Invitation, Young Washington, and Game of Thrones Prequel: Dragon Clan also in the spotlight. Next up are Escape from Death Street and OK Boss Lady 2.

industryHighlights.text: 今日零新片上映，市场依靠本周4部新片维持热度。
industryHighlights.en: No new film opened today; the market relies on the four new titles from this week.

industryHighlights.text: 系列IP占据热搜头部，《蜘蛛侠》与《小黄人》表现最强劲。
industryHighlights.en: Franchise IPs dominate the trending chart, with Spider-Man and Minions strongest.

industryHighlights.text: 《逃出绝命街》与《OK老板娘2》已列入待映，暑期档后续仍有新血。
industryHighlights.en: Escape from Death Street and OK Boss Lady 2 are on the upcoming slate, adding fresh titles to the summer season.

industryHighlights.text: 本周新片数量有限，头部作品的票房竞争可能更集中。
industryHighlights.en: With limited new releases this week, box-office competition may be concentrated among top titles.
